caption: The drawing contains two lace patterns rendered in black and brown ink on a plain, light beige background. The top lace pattern depicts a bow with two trailing ribbons. Each ribbon is wide, featuring a repeating floral design with leaf motifs and a scalloped edge, accentuated with brown highlights on the floral elements. The lace bow is detailed, with crisscrossed threadwork and small floral forms decorating its surface. Below the bow, there is a rectangular lace panel, also bordered with a scalloped edge. The panel is filled with a grid of interlocking lines, with regularly spaced clusters of five-petaled flowers, each with brown shading on the petals. Both lace designs display intricate threadwork and detailed patterns. In the lower right corner, the name "LILLAN COASEY" is stamped in small, capital letters.
title: Tie and Cuff
